say:28:1511241021:0.text: ... A coward is all I see.

say:30:1511241022:0.text: You...! Enough! The goddess is gone! Your kind serves no purpose now!
say:30:1511241022:0.source_cn: 你……！哼，神已经不在，巫祭也不该存在。

say:31:1511241023:0.source_cn: 战士们，击溃这些叛乱之徒！
